# cursor_origin_repo_grants (Data Source)

Lists the direct grants on an Origin repository. Access inherited from namespace grants is not included. Uses the provider auth token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_origin_repo_grants" "rocket" {
  owner = "acme"
  repo  = "rocket"
}

output "rocket_admins" {
  value = [for g in data.cursor_origin_repo_grants.rocket.grants : g.id if g.permission == "admin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `owner` (String) Owner slug of the repository.
- `repo` (String) Repository name within the owner.

### Read-Only

- `grants` (Attributes List) Direct grants on the repository. permission is read, write, admin, or custom. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))

<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Read-Only:

- `group` (Attributes) Set when the grant is for a Cursor org group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants--group))
- `id` (String) Composite grant ID in the form accepted by the matching grant resource import.
- `permission` (String) Permission preset. custom marks a grant whose policy is not a public preset.
- `team_group` (Attributes) Set when the grant is a team floor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants--team_group))
- `user` (Attributes) Set when the grant is for one user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants--user))

<a id="nestedatt--grants--group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants.group`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Cursor org group public ID (grp_...). The Organization Admin API returns it as publicId; its internal g_ id is not accepted.


<a id="nestedatt--grants--team_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants.team_group`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) members or admins: every member, or every admin, of the team that owns the resource. Rejected on user-owned resources.


<a id="nestedatt--grants--user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants.user`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) User ID (user_...).
